title: UCR United Taiwanese Student Association
content_html:
The UCR United Taiwanese Student Association (UTSA) is a student organization at the University of California, Riverside oriented toward students from Taiwan. According to its Facebook page, the organization aims to give opportunities for Taiwanese students studying at UCR to communicate and make friends. It maintains a Facebook page at @UCRUTSA and an Instagram account at @ucr_utsa.

The organization has a limited documented web presence — its Facebook page shows 28 likes and no additional detail about events, founding history, or formal programming. No dedicated website, Linktree, or HighlanderLink listing was identified in available first-party sources. Activity level and current registration status could not be confirmed.
